description: This file defines the LogWrapper class, a helper that wraps Android's native Log utility to facilitate logging with the ability to pipe logs to additional LogNode recipients. It implements the LogNode interface, maintains a chain of LogNode objects, and provides methods to set and get the next node, as well as to print log messages with optional exception information.

classes.name: LogWrapper
classes.description: A class that wraps Android's native Log utility to implement the LogNode interface, allowing log messages to be printed and piped to other LogNode objects.

methods.name: getNext
methods.description: Returns the next LogNode in the linked list.

methods.name: setNext
methods.description: Sets the next LogNode to which log data will be sent.

methods.name: println
methods.description: Prints a log message with specified priority, tag, message, and optional Throwable; then forwards the log to the next node if available.
